description: Twenty self-authored English, Chinese and cross-language retrieval questions with independent passage labels. Actual cached default models, not ranking replay.
provenance: Self-authored public ML/engineering explanations; no private project/design content, production documents or canned rankings. Labels defined before model execution.

cases.prompt: How can I independently verify a claimed test accuracy from saved neural-network weights?
Which split must stay unseen while choosing features and tuning hyperparameters?
How should a small CPU smoke experiment compare an MLP and a convolutional classifier fairly?
What should be rerun after invalid experiment metrics when the approved source code is already saved?
How do I check that a cited assertion is actually supported by its source passage?
How can a resumable agent enforce its usage ceiling without losing charges after a restart?
Where should provider credentials go, and what must be excluded from model prompts and Git commits?
Why does replaying a prerecorded result order fail to evaluate neural semantic retrieval?
显存有限时，怎样通过多个小批次实现一次较大批次的参数更新？
验证集损失连续多个轮次没有改善时，通常怎样停止训练并选择检查点？
少数类别识别很差但总体准确率很高，应增加哪些分类评估指标？
比较两个模型时，应如何固定随机性并保存可复现实验的条件？
用户提供的文件路径怎样校验，才能避免越过工作区或通过链接访问其他目录？
训练刚开始时梯度不稳定，怎样让学习率从较小值逐步达到目标值？
向量相似度与词项检索得分量纲不同，怎样合并两路搜索排名？
多个实验共用数据集时，如何防止训练脚本修改原始样本，并保存新产物？
如何根据保存的模型权重重新推理，独立复核报告中的测试准确率，而不是只相信指标 JSON？
做特征选择和调参时，怎样避免提前使用最终测试集而造成评估偏乐观？
A classifier has high overall accuracy but misses the rare class. Which additional metrics should I report?
How do I preserve random seeds, data splits and environment details for a reproducible model comparison?
